categories.main_business_segments: Woosung Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacture and sale of compound feed for livestock, aquaculture, and companion animals. The company also engages in management and licensing of intellectual property rights, provides administrative support services to subsidiaries, and operates real estate leasing. Its subsidiaries focus on feed production and sales in Korea, Vietnam, and China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced feed formulation technologies developed in collaboration with international research institutions such as Schothorst Feed Research from the Netherlands. It operates specialized production lines for general livestock feed and special feeds for aquaculture and pets, with ISO9001 and HACCP certifications ensuring quality and safety. Production capacity is managed across multiple domestic and overseas plants with a focus on high-quality, eco-friendly feed products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Woosung serves livestock farmers, aquaculture operators, and pet owners, with direct sales to feed users comprising the majority of revenue. Sales channels include direct transactions with farmers, dealers, and agricultural cooperatives. The domestic market is the primary consumption area, with growing demand in companion animal feed. Overseas markets include Vietnam and China, targeting local livestock and aquaculture sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in South Korea (Nonsan, Gyeongsan, Asan) and overseas in Vietnam and China. Sales and production activities are concentrated in South Korea, with expanding operations in Southeast Asia and China. The majority of sales are domestic, with international sales representing a smaller but strategic portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Woosung operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and sale of compound feed products. It sources raw materials mainly from international suppliers, particularly from the U.S., and supplies finished feed products directly to end-users in livestock and aquaculture industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D to develop high-quality, high-efficiency, and eco-friendly feed products tailored to different livestock species and companion animals. It invests in expanding research personnel and collaborates with global feed research institutions. Innovation focuses include premium feed formulations for beef cattle, swine, poultry, aquaculture, and pets, with ongoing development of new products and intellectual property management.
categories.revenue_model: Woosung generates revenue predominantly through the sale of compound feed products, accounting for over 95% of total sales. Additional revenue streams include sales of feed-related goods, licensing of intellectual property, administrative services to subsidiaries, and real estate leasing. The company’s sales are mostly domestic with some export sales to Vietnam and China.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive and mature domestic feed market characterized by numerous players including agricultural cooperatives and feed associations. Woosung differentiates itself through high-quality, eco-friendly products, international technology partnerships, and a growing global presence. It is positioned as a leading specialized feed manufacturer with expanding overseas operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Woosung reported consolidated revenues of approximately 634.8 billion KRW, showing a 3.7% increase from the previous year. The company’s total assets stand at about 4.25 trillion KRW with equity of 1.83 trillion KRW. Operating profit turned positive with 5.7 billion KRW, and net income rose significantly due to asset disposals and foreign exchange gains. The company maintains a stable capital structure with a debt-to-equity ratio around 133%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Woosung offers high-quality, eco-friendly compound feeds developed through advanced research collaborations and certified quality management systems. Its product differentiation lies in specialized feed formulations for various livestock and companion animals, supported by technical expertise and innovation. The company also provides integrated services including brand management and administrative support to subsidiaries, enhancing overall group competitiveness.
